Sonic Generations or Sonic Adventure?

Sonic Adventure was a bit of an RPG or open-world game that was completely 3D and allowed you to follow the story from place to place. The voice acting was great, and they did a surprisingly good job considering it was the first attempt (as far as I know) to bring Sonic to 3D gameplay. Sonic Adventure 2 was the follow-up. It was a little more linear in its story with more traditional levels and less exploring, but also a great 3D game.

Sonic Generations is one of my favorites because while it had a linear level progression like the original 2D Sonic games, each stage was completed in two parts; one part was done with a classic-looking Sonic on a two-dimensional track, and one part was done on a 3D track similar to Sonic Adventure. I thought it was the perfect marriage of old and new, and brought a simple, no-gimmicks approach to modern Sonic games. I'm hoping they take a page out of Generations' book for their next game and just work on providing a simple and fun experience.
